sinopsis.es: El intelectual palestino Edward Said queda retratado con sus propias palabras, a partir de décadas de archivo, para explorar el legado de obras que abrieron camino como Orientalismo y La cuestión palestina.
sinopsis.en: Palestinian scholar Edward Said is profiled in his own words, drawing upon decades of archives, to explore the legacy of his groundbreaking works including Orientalism and The Question of Palestine.
